rule_audit.name: Timely full tender of rent refused
rule_audit.label: Timely full tender of rent refused (Pinewood Gardens Apts. v. Whiteside, 2014-Ohio-2305)
rule_audit.summary: A landlord may not refuse timely full rent, including during an applicable grace period, and then evict for nonpayment of that rent.
rule_audit.source: Iskin (6th ed. 2022), § II.J-K; Pinewood Gardens Apts. v. Whiteside, 2014-Ohio-2305; Professional Investments of America, Inc. v. Ross, No. 44540, 1982 WL 2579
